verdict.rationale: The evidence says nothing about how flag changes reach connected SDKs: no real-time streaming, no polling interval and no propagation latency. The 'kill switch' line (docs-50) and the 'toggle without deploying' line (gh-1) describe toggling a flag remotely, not how fast that change propagates. The self-hosted Edge Proxy (docs-14) is about running evaluation close to your servers, not update delivery speed, so none of these count toward this story.
